adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Post#cook` to `return raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), bypassing the normal cooking/rendering pipeline (which would typically sanitize/normalize HTML). The new embedding/feed import path explicitly creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` (TopicEmbed.import via PostCreator, and PollFeed/import_remote pull HTML from RSS/readability) and then views render it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). There is no sanitization step added for this raw HTML path, so untrusted feed/remote content can become unsanitized cooked HTML and be consumed/rendered elsewhere, matching the finding’s contract-change/security concern.
